title: Track Mix 4-Mix Duo #07 (일반 부채꼴·매끈 / 임산부 동심원·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each from a different look, each with her own multi-material blended body.

#1: Italian, in her late 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. A dramatically impossible waist-to-hip ratio dominates her silhouette: a colossal heavy bust, an extremely sharply cinched waist pulled in far tighter than the waistline of any of her other curves, and then enormous round hips flaring out to a width many times greater than that narrow waist. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a gigantic rounded rear. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Not a plus-size model, not evenly proportioned. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in elegant updo, real pores, real living eyes, 15 clicker rings piercings set with diamonds in bronze-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of platinum a necklace. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 59% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 4 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 3 o'clock, 6 o'clock, 8 o'clock and 12 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 3 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 3 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Norwegian, in her late 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her hips and rear so wide. A high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly projects forward prominently from her front, while behind it a rear so massively rounded and projecting dominates from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape, echoing the belly's own roundness from the opposite side. A full round bust above the belly, gigantic thick thighs. Her head looks small on top of her body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin with a light scatter of freckles, strong straight defined dark-blonde brows, warm bronze shadow across the lids, a fine brown liner, long lashes, large pale-blue eyes with bright real catchlights, soft contour, a muted red-brown lip, a fierce, steady, commanding expression, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a mohawk with volume along the centre of the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 15 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with rubies in gold-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of gold a bracelet. Fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 46% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 29%, 60% and 84% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, shishi lion-dog formations in DEEP GOLD and CRIMSON, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
